    {

      "place": "Cologne",
      "source_span": "Possibly Baron von Bernus, Heidelberg. (Galerie Dr. H. Burg, Cologne)."
    },
    {
      "owner": "Dr. Georg S.Hirschland",
      "role": "collector",
      "date": "1885-1942",
      "year": null,
      "place": "Essen and New York",
      "source_span": "Dr. Georg S.Hirschland [1885-1942], Essen and New York;"
    },
    {
      "owner": "Fred Triest",
      "role": "heir",
      "date": "1914-1999",
      "year": null,
      "place": "San Francisco",
      "source_span": "his son-in-law, Fred Triest [1914-1999], San Francisco;"
    },
    {
      "owner": "Wolfgang Ratjen",
      "role": "collector",
      "date": "1996",
      "year": 1996,
      "place": "Munich",
      "source_span": "sold 1996 to Wolfgang Ratjen, Munich;"
    },
    {
      "owner": "NGA",
      "role": "museum",
      "date": "2007",
      "year": 2007,
      "place": null,
      "source_span": "purchased 2007 by NGA."
    },
    {
      "owner": "Museum Folkwang",
      "role": "museum",
      "date": "1938",
      "year": 1938,
      "place": "Essen",
      "source_span": "In 1938 Georg Hirschland, a patron of the Museum Folkwang, Essen, emigrated to the United States with his family..."
    },
    {
      "owner": "city of Essen",
      "role": "museum",
      "date": "1939",
      "year": 1939,
      "place": "Essen",
      "source_span": "the Museum Folkwang and the city of Essen raised the funds to purchase the collection to keep it together;"
    },
    {
      "owner": "Allied forces",
      "role": "confiscating agency",
      "date": "1946",
      "year": 1946,
      "place": "mine near Siegen",
      "source_span": "evacuated, with other paintings from the Folkwang, to a mine near Siegen, where they were recovered by Allied forces and taken in June 1946 to the Collecting Point at Marburg..."
    },
    {
      "owner": "Collecting Point at Marburg",
      "role": "collecting point",
      "date": "1946",
      "year": 1946,
      "place": "Marburg",
      "source_span": "taken in June 1946 to the Collecting Point at Marburg, in the American zone of Occupied Germany."
    },
    {
      "owner": "French zone",
      "role": "collecting point",
      "date": "1947",
      "year": 1947,
      "place": "French zone",
      "source_span": "Other Hirschland objects were discovered in a convent in the French zone, and several drawings, including the Koch, were identified as being in a palace Hugenpost bei Kettwig, near Essen, in the British zone, in 1947."
    },
    {
      "owner": "British zone",
      "role": "collecting point",
      "date": "1947",
      "year": 1947,
      "place": "British zone",
      "source_span": "several drawings, including the Koch, were identified as being in a palace Hugenpost bei Kettwig, near Essen, in the British zone, in 1947."
    },
    {
      "owner": "Collecting Point in Wiesbaden",
      "role": "collecting point",
      "date": "1946",
      "year": 1946,
      "place": "Wiesbaden",
      "source_span": "The 11 paintings in Marburg were transferred by September 1946 to the Collecting Point in Wiesbaden, and in October 1948 were transferred to the British zone (Receipt for Interzonal Exchange dated 19 October 1938, NARA M1941/reel 45)."
    },
    {
      "owner": "British Control Council for Germany",
      "role": "confiscating agency",
      "date": "1951",
      "year": 1951,
      "place": "British zone",
      "source_span": "By 1951 it appears that all but one of the Hirschland objects in the British zone had been released to the estate in the United States. The sole holdout was an El Greco for which there was difficulty in obtaining an export permit."
    }
  ]
}
